description: This file contains a series of shell script tests for the 'git clone' command, specifically testing the '-c' option for setting configuration variables during cloning. It sets up various cloning scenarios and verifies the resulting repository configurations and files.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executing the provided commands and verifying their outcomes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, used for negative testing scenarios.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within error output or files.

methods.name: test_path_is_hidden
methods.description: Checks whether a given path is hidden based on configuration.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the repository with specified attributes.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file or output.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Executes cleanup commands after tests are run.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or outputs.
